senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be or make loose, soft,] to be healed, relieved; to heal.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 60a:28">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>ותִרְפָּאֵנִי</he> and do thou heal me, v. <cite ref="T00933"><he>רְפוּאָה</he></cite>. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 23">B’shall. 23</cite> <he>וכשרְפָאָהוּ בסערה רְפָאוֹ</he> and when he came to heal him (Job), he healed him in a windstorm; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 235:4">Yalk. Ex. 235</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 55b:11">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>ואם צריכים רפואה רְפָאֵם וכ׳</he> and if they (my dreams) need remedy, remedy them as thou didst the waters of Marah &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="T00934"><he>רָפוּי</he></cite>. Sifra M’tsorʿa, <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4">Neg. ch. IV</cite>, Par. 7; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T00942">same</cite>. Yalk. Ex. l. c. <he>הוא רי׳ וכ׳</he> he healed Job in a windstorm. Ber. l. c. <he>לפי שאין דרכן … לרַפְּאוֹת וכ׳</he> because it is not for man to cure, but it is the custom (to employ physicians). Ib. <he>שניתנה … לרפאות</he>, v. <cite ref="T00422"><he>רוֹפֵא</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 4:4">Ned. IV, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Nedarim 38b:8">38ᵇ</cite>) <he>ומְרַפְּאֵהוּ רפואת וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>ומְרַפְּאוֹ</he>) and he may attend to him as a physician to his body &c., v. <cite ref="T00678"><he>רִיפּוּי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 29:1">Pesik. R. s. 29-30</cite>-30 <he>כל מה דאמר ירמיה ופרע אתא ישעיהו ור׳</he> whatever Jeremiah spoke and tore (prophesied evil), Isaiah came and healed (restored) it; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be cured, be treated; to get well.
units: Pes. 25ᵃ בכל מִתְרַפְּאִין חוץ מעצי וכ׳ you may apply anything (otherwise forbidden) as a remedy, except wood of an ăsherah.
<cite ref="Pesachim 25a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>בכל מתרפאין חוץ מעבודת וכ׳</he> you may employ any remedy except idolatrous objects, lawless gratification, and bloodshed.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105a:15">Keth. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>ספק מִתְרַפֵּא וכ׳</he> it is doubtful whether or not he will get well.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:2">Ab. Zar. II, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00678"><he>רִיפּוּי</he></cite>; a. fr.
